_comment: Shared by rust/geometry/tests/placement_chain_parity.rs (the resolver) and packages/data/src/placement-chain.parity.test.ts (walkPlacementChain). #7791 item 4, D26/D27/D30. `links` maps a placement id to its PlacementRelTo (null = root) and the translation its RelativePlacement adds. `expect.chain` is leaf-first; the world origin is the sum of the chain's offsets (translation-only links commute, so the sum proves exactly which links were composed). A cycle is refused, never composed partially.

vectors.name: a mid-chain start composes only its ancestors
a placement that references itself is a cycle
a two-placement cycle is a cycle
a tail leading into a cycle is a cycle, not a partial frame
